programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Tent City
programmes.d: Today's hunt takes Dog far from the glittering hotels of Waikiki to the parts of Hawaii tourist rarely see, Oahu's ramshackle tent cities. The team searches for a woman who has lost almost everything, her home, her family and her spirit.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Dead of Night
programmes.d: Dog's good friend and fellow bondsman Chris is running out of time. He has only days to find his fugitive or risk losing his business. In his hunt Dog confronts duplicitous tipsters, vicious attack dogs, and hostile neighbors.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Montrose Files: The Million Dollar Man Pt. 1
programmes.d: Dog launches a high stake hunt through the desolate and dangerous mountain landscape of western Colorado in pursuit of a gun-loving survivalist with a million dollar bond on his head. Will Dog's plan of using brains over brawn work?

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Montrose Files: The Million Dollar Man Pt. 2
programmes.d: Once in Montrose, Dog discovers that the million dollar fugitive is not the young bondsman's only problem. Dog and Beth make it their mission to both clean up the mess and teach him the fundamentals of bondsmanship.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Montrose Files: Round the Clock
programmes.d: Dog is committed to saving his new friend's bail bonding business, and now must race against time to bring a rogues gallery to justice in the High Sierra mountain town of Montrose, CO.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Montrose Files: And Then There Were None
programmes.d: With four outlaws still on the lam, Dog sets out to bring 'em in. As day turns into night and with the darkness and the danger mounting, an undaunted Dog and team plan late night hits on the riskiest of locations--their targets' homes.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Oh Brother, Where Art Thou?
programmes.d: With a long record of violence and abuse and weighing in at over 200lbs, Dog's target for the day does not sound like a gentle giant. When the trail grows cold Dog turns up the heat on the fugitive's brother and sister.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Cap and Gown
programmes.d: Friend of the family, Kili, is joining the team to help track down a runner on the Hawaiian island of Maui. This is not the only thing on their schedule, because after the hunt, Kili has to hurry off to his college graduation ceremony!

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: And Baby Makes Three
programmes.d: Leland has to attend a Lamaze class before he can join the hunt--another Chapman is on the way! But when Dog starts to go after this accused jewelry thief without his fastest son, he learns that this fugitive puts the "R" in runner.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Tender Trap
programmes.d: When Dog discovers today's prey is a notorious ladies man, he knows just how to lure him in. The trap includes a suggestive phone call, a motel rendezvous, and a crew of bounty hunters waiting in the next room ready to break up the party!

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Greed is Good
programmes.d: Today's fugitive is accused of assaulting a police officer, so Dog and the team are not taking any chances. Dog has to play on his target's greed and deploy some modern technology to set a trap for this runner.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Tears for Fears
programmes.d: Baby Lyssa wakes up in a jail cell, but ignores the ensuing media frenzy in order to befriend a woman waging a personal battle against drug addiction.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Picture This
programmes.d: A fugitive with a long criminal record has fled to Hawaii, and the bondsman on the mainland has asked Dog for help. Dog doesn't have much information to work with, but he can use the felon's desire to impress his friends to track him down.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Tag, You're It
programmes.d: To his traditional bounty hunting tools of confidential informants, canvassing, and silver-tongued subterfuge the world's greatest bounty hunter has added Facebook! A word to the wise for those on the run-post at your own peril, the Dog is watching!

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: A Family Affair
programmes.d: Dog likes to say, "The apple doesn't fall far from the tree," and this is a hunt where that is true. So will Dog be able to use one family member's troubled ways to catch another one in trouble with the law?

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Training Day
programmes.d: While the team tries to handle the bond that newcomer Alysin wrote incorrectly, sparks are flying between Beth and Duane Lee when he questions Beth's decision to go on the hunt without Dog leading the charge!

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Cutting the Apron Strings
programmes.d: Two different young men both have a bad habit of missing their court dates. Looking over their files Dog senses that they have another trait in common, both are a little too tied to their mothers.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Short Handed
programmes.d: Dog's target today has a history of violence, and apparently plans to re-locate without notifying the proper authorities. Unfortunately the team is missing a key player, Duane Lee is MIA today distracted by his new lady love.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Photo Op
programmes.d: Dog and Duane Lee can't agree about what role Duane Lee should have in the family business. But the family comes together as they set out to hunt a chronic violator with an open warrant and a wife who has an odd request for Dog.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: A House Divided
programmes.d: Dog has dropped Duane Lee from the team. When Leland confronts Dog and Beth about the decision tempers flare. But they have to come together to answer a cry for help from a mother who feels that the safest place for her daughter is jail.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: All Grown Up
programmes.d: Cecily has graduated from High School and Dog believes the time is right to show her what the family business is all about. The rough and tumble world of bounty hunting is very different than the all girls private school she attended.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Fight Like A Girl
programmes.d: This one is close to home. Dog's target on today's hunt is the cousin of Kali, Garry Boy's caregiver. In addition, she has a reputation as a brawler. With Duane Lee still missing from the team Baby Lyssa decides she will step-up in this hunt.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Higher Power
programmes.d: In an attempt to bring the team back together, Dog recruits his pastor, Tim Storey, to be the peacemaker. As Dog begins his hunt for a young man who has trouble showing up at court, Tim has his own mission - convince Duane Lee to meet with him.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Ties That Bind
programmes.d: With Duane Lee back on the team, the rift in the Chapman clan appears over. But will time heal this wound? As the family heads out for the seedier side of Honolulu in search of an erotic dancer, we will find out if the wound is truly healed.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Who's the Boss
programmes.d: When can a bounty hunt also be a date? When Dog and Beth decide to ride in the same SUV as they pursue a run away fugitive, will their different approaches to the investigation lead to a capture and romance?

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bus Stop Bruiser
programmes.d: When an alleged abuser goes on the lame, Dog gathers the team to bring him in. As the leads grow colder Dog's determination only grows stronger. Finally, a hot lead comes in and Dog sets the trap for his prey.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Luck Be A Lady
programmes.d: Dog and company head to the Big Island in pursuit of two courthouse no-shows only to find that one of them appears to be posting status updates from Southern California.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Behind the Hunt
programmes.d: The cameras are turned around, as we get a tour of life "behind the scenes" on Dog the Bounty Hunter. Using interviews with Dog and the posse, the TV crew, and never before seen footage, this is one of most revealing and heartfelt episodes of the series.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: God Looks on the Heart
programmes.d: This fugitive spells trouble for Dog in today's hunt. When the leads grow cold it's the US Postal Service to the rescue as a mail carrier lends a helping hand. Dog's team surrounds the suspected safe house and silently awaits their prey.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Big Brother
programmes.d: Today's case involves a Samoan so Dog knows that the runner's close-knit kinfolk hold the keys to bringing him in. Dog's plan is to convince family that everyone is best served if the fugitive mans up and takes care of business.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Mid-Course Correction
programmes.d: Dog's target for today was once an upstanding member of his community. Now with no home, no job and the law on his trail, this middle-aged exile from middle-class society is using the cold end of an ice pipe to soothe his troubled soul.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Baby's Back in Town
programmes.d: Dog tries to nab a fugitive, named Wayne, by calling and telling him that he's won a new vacuum cleaner and he should stick around to get it. Dog then sends his daughter, Lyssa, to "deliver" the vacuum cleaner and lure Wayne out of his house.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Surprise! Surprise!
programmes.d: Dog and his team are out to revoke bail on Eugene, a chronic heroin addict. They find him in a squalid apartment with a huge stockpile of syringes, and they can see that his physical condition is deteriorating.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: No Ice in Paradise
programmes.d: Dog and his team fight the war on ice-crystal methamphetamine-on many fronts. They appear on a special anti-drug float in a parade. Then they go after bail-jumping Pana, a convicted drug dealer.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Fathers in Law
programmes.d: Hunting down a fugitive known as "Bozo," Dog gets help from an unexpected source, Bozo's father-in-law.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Bosco the Clown
programmes.d: Dog and the team get a big surprise after they track down Bosco, a fugitive who they believe is addicted to methamphetamines. They discover he's off drugs, settling into a normal life with a new girlfriend, and is very friendly.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Brother's Keeper
programmes.d: Leland has a full plate of fugitives in Kona, and the whole family heads to the Big Island to help.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Mama's Boys
programmes.d: Dog visits his mother's grave for inspiration before heading out to find Frankie, a violent fugitive hiding in the jungle. The spirit of Ma Chapman seems to help when Dog finds an unusual ally; Frankie's mother.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Lost in Paradise
programmes.d: Dog lectures high school students about the dangers of drugs before going after Joseph, a dangerous fugitive who won't be easy to capture.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: Coaching Day
programmes.d: Dog takes the day off to try his hand at coaching, and assigns Tim and Leland to track down a dangerous fugitive on their own. Can the boys prove they can handle it?

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: The Women of Waikiki
programmes.d: The boys get distracted by the bikini-clad lovelies on Waikiki when they hunt for Lucy, a homeless, alcoholic fugitive. Beth is amused by the boys, but this is serious business: Tim will have to pay the bond if Lucy isn't caught.

programmes.t: Dog The Bounty Hunter: To Capture One's Own
programmes.d: Dog faces a tough personal and professional situation when he must hunt down his friend, Ili, who has helped him on many busts. But now Ili's on the other side of the law, and now Dog must bring her in.
